title: Renew a driving instructor licence
summary: This page provides information on how to renew a driving instructor licence, depending on how long ago your licence expired.
intro:
Driving instructor licences expire after 5 years. A renewal notice will be posted to you 2 months before your licence expiry date.

You are unable to renew your driving instructor licence more than 2 months before its expiry date.

How you renew your driving instructor licence will depend on how long ago the licence expired.
who_can_apply: If your licence expired within the last 90 days, you are eligible to renew online.
If your licence expired between 90 days and 2 years ago, you are not eligible to renew and must submit an application for a new licence.
If your licence expired more than 2 years ago, you are not eligible to renew and must submit an application for a new licence.
If your licence expired more than 90 days ago, you must apply for a driving instructor licence.
what_you_need: Paid the non-refundable fee for the issue of a 5-year driving instructor licence.
Successfully completed the instructor knowledge test for the class of licence you wish to instruct (the test is in English and interpreter assistance is not permitted).
Your current NSW employee Working With Children Check (WWCC) number (Class C and R applicants only).
Scanned PDF copies of your driver licence and traffic record details from an Interstate Licensing Authority (if applicable).

If your licence expired between 90 days and 2 years ago, you need to provide a commercial medical assessment – PDF no more than 6 months old (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45065806-medical-assessment-for-driving-instructors.pdf).
If your licence expired more than 2 years ago, you must submit a new application for a driving instructor licence.

how_to_steps.text: Check the What you need section.
Select the 'Renew online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your renewal application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your renewal application.

faqs.q: How far in advance can I renew my driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You cannot renew your driving instructor licence more than 2 months before its expiry date.

faqs.q: If my licence expired more than 90 days ago, can I still renew it?
faqs.a: Applications for licences that expired more than 90 days ago are no longer considered renewals. You need to submit a new driving instructor licence application.

faqs.q: What do I need to renew my licence online?
faqs.a: You must have paid the non-refundable fee for the issue of a 5-year driving instructor licence, successfully completed the instructor knowledge test, and gathered required documents like your driver licence and WWCC number (if applicable).
